description: D054 unapproved reference comparison with the current producer-reviewed landscape candidate pinned per stanza; independent exact-checksum review pending for new selections.
review_notice: Unapproved D054 reference comparison. Each row uses the listed exact candidate version and checksum. Prior independent exact-checksum passes remain pinned for S001 v005, S003 v005, S004 v010, and S005 v004. Current producer review passed S002 v008, S006 v012, and S008 v006; S007 v009, S009 v008, and S010 v007 retain measured borderline skin results with uncertainty recorded. Older failed versions and reports remain in the candidate history. No art approval.
visual_review_status: Producer reviews are recorded for every selected candidate. Prior independent exact-checksum reviews apply only to S001 v005, S003 v005, S004 v010 and S005 v004. The exact selected versions S002 v008, S006 v012, S007 v009, S008 v006, S009 v008 and S010 v007 need independent review; S007, S009 and S010 have measured borderline warm-skin results disclosed in candidate_status. No art approval.

rows.scene: Saubhari sits in meditation beneath the clear surface of the Kalindi, with a small fish shoal nearby; Garuda appears overhead at the riverbank, seen by the sage. Keep the underwater and surface layers legible within one continuous landscape scene. No split collage.
rows.candidate_status: Independent exact-checksum review passed this exact v005 candidate. Prior producer review noted a borderline chest patch R−B 119; independent review measured R−B 121 and judged the full-frame tone warm russet-brown. Firstmate directed retaining the independently passed version.

rows.scene: At the river surface, Garuda takes one fish from the water as Saubhari watches from below or the bank and raises a restrained hand in a spoken curse. A few fish remain in the water; avoid graphic injury.
rows.candidate_status: Producer review passed this exact v008 candidate after removing Garuda’s uncontracted jewelry. The prior independent needs-fix applies to v006 only; v008 awaits independent exact-checksum review.

rows.scene: Garuda drives the proud hooded Kaliya toward the dark waters of Kalindi. Show one continuous serpent body entering the river, with Garuda’s two wings clearly attached. A small ritual offering remains on the bank as context for the cause.
rows.candidate_status: Independent exact-checksum review passed this exact v005 candidate; Garuda’s jewelry is removed and his contracted simple ochre cloth remains.

rows.scene: A poisoned stretch of Kalindi damages the riverbank: two clearly separate dried trees, a few birds falling toward the ground, and one youthful Krishna watching with compassion from the bank. Do not show Kaliya or a physical poison cloud, halo, or light rays.
rows.candidate_status: Independent exact-checksum review passed this exact v010 candidate. The reviewer counted one clear toe tip and 2–3 implied lesser-toe strokes on the side-view far foot and judged it a normal side view; producer’s separate count concern remains preserved.

rows.scene: On a very hot day, young Krishna has entered the Yamuna forest without Balarama. Thirsty cowherds and a modest herd drink from the poisoned river; Krishna is present but does not drink. Show a calm, non-graphic warning moment before collapse.
rows.candidate_status: Independent exact-checksum review passed this exact v004 candidate. The reviewer judged the measured gopa shoulder patch R−B 126 warm ochre-brown in the full frame; prior producer concern remains preserved.

rows.scene: Krishna comes close to the fallen cowherds and cows and compassionately restores them with his sidelong glance. Show several figures beginning to rise and breathe; the nectar-like mercy is conveyed through gesture, water, and expression only, with no rays or beams.
rows.candidate_status: Producer review passed exact v012. Eight 15x15 skin-only patches measured R−B 95–114; Krishna face B−R 82. The earlier independent needs-fix applies to v005, not this candidate. Independent review pending.

rows.scene: Three distinct adult cowherds rise in wonder at the bliss throughout their bodies, recognize Krishna’s act, and embrace him with natural, connected limbs. Keep the embrace readable and the hands visible only where they can be clearly drawn.
rows.candidate_status: Best candidate after two localized skin-only edits: v009. Five 15x15 skin samples include R−B 127, 132, 128, 117 and 127; four exceed the approximate 120 guide. Full-frame tone reads warm-brown to copper-brown; independent reviewer should judge this exact candidate.

rows.scene: A small distinct herd of newly revived cows gathers around Krishna, gazing at him with joyful, moist eyes and open gentle mouths. Krishna remains the single clear youthful figure; keep each animal’s legs and head distinct.
rows.candidate_status: Producer review passed exact v006. Both hands resting on cow heads show a thumb plus four separate fingers; Krishna face samples have B−R 51 and 52. Independent review pending.

rows.scene: A few distinct cowherds show gooseflesh and overwhelming joy, then bow at Krishna’s feet with reverent prayer. Keep Krishna’s smooth forehead bare as contracted, and make every visible open hand anatomically clear with a thumb plus four fingers.
rows.candidate_status: Best combined hand and skin version after two localized skin-only edits: v008. Eight 15x15 human-skin samples measured R−B 104, 121, 126, 126, 125, 120, 117 and 120; four exceed the approximate 120 guide. Full-frame skin reads brown to reddish-copper; independent reviewer should judge this exact candidate.

rows.scene: A quiet devotional closing scene: Bhattathiri kneels before youthful Krishna, praying for protection and release from illness; two recovered cowherds stand nearby as beneficiaries of the same mercy. Krishna’s compassion is conveyed by a gentle sidelong gaze and an open blessing hand. No halo beams; fingers clear.
rows.candidate_status: Best candidate after two localized skin-only edits: v007. Eight 15x15 human-skin samples measured R−B 108, 119, 115, 116, 115, 113, 122 and 113; one exceeds the approximate 120 guide. Full-frame skin reads brown with a reddish cast; independent reviewer should judge this exact candidate.
